SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM SCMTPODT_KEP WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'DMTR' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE ,PLANT ,LEGACY_PO_NO ,LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,STATUS ,BUYER_ITEM_NO ,CURRENCY_CODE ,UNIT_PRICE ,ITEM_QTY ,ITEM_AMT ,ADD_DATE ,RD_DATE ,DELY_TO_LOCATION ,PURCHASE_USER_ID ,LEGACY_PR_NO ,REQ_USER_NAME ,REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME ,REQ_USER_TEL ,REMARK ,PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID FROM SCMTPODT_KEP WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE SCMTPODT_KEP SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
